PersistentLayer
|
|-- DiagramStore                                  main repository facade
|   |
|   |-- Project
|   |   |-- id / name
|   |   `-- Mapping canvas identities
|   |
|   |-- revisionStore: RevisionStore
|   |   |-- owns immutable DiagramRevision records
|   |   |-- owns immutable StoredCanvasSnapshot records
|   |   |-- owns durable DiagramEditContext heads
|   |   `-- owns CanvasRecord published heads
|   |
|   `-- projectCatalogs: ProjectCatalogStore       owns source catalogs and projection relationships
|       |
|       |-- projection relationships
|       |   |-- source / target canvas and revision references
|       |   `-- links: source evidence -> target tree nodes
|       |
|       |-- CompactionCatalog
|       |   |-- activeByPath[path] ----------------> compactions[id]
|       |   `-- compactions[id]: FileCompaction
|       |       |-- source path / source hash
|       |       |-- startLine / endLine
|       |       |-- originalLines
|       |       `-- compactedSource                retained source presentation
|       |
|       `-- Operations
|           |-- saveMappingDiagram(...)
|           |   `-- calls DiagramEditService.publish(...)
|           |       |-- Mapping application layer owns reconciliation
|           |       `-- writes snapshots / published heads through RevisionStore
|           |
|           |-- saveProjectedTree(...)
|           |   `-- DiagramEditService -> revision history + projection relationship.
|           |
|           `-- archiveRepresentation(...)
|               `-- Retire canvas identity while retaining its revision history.
|
|-- MappingWorkspaceStore                         owns the saved editing session
|   |
|   `-- MappingWorkspaceSnapshot
|       |-- projectId
|       |-- activeDocumentId ---------------------> documents[id]
|       |
|       `-- documents[]: MappingDocumentSnapshot
|           |-- document identity / name
|           |-- canvasId ------------------------> RevisionStore.canvases
|           |-- editContextId --------------------> RevisionStore.editContexts
|           |
|           |-- canvas                            retained panes and controls
|           `-- viewport                          camera position
|               |
|               |-- Open canvas -------> restore or create its editing context.
|               |-- Publish -----------> reconcile and save through DiagramEditService.
|               `-- Save workspace ----> context handles + personal view state.
|
`-- SearchArtifact persistence                    PROPOSED derived output
    |
    |-- DiagramSearchArtifact
    |   |-- derived from -------------------------> immutable DiagramRevision content
    |   |-- searchable text                       node labels with original line labels
    |   `-- row metadata -------------------------> node ID + original text location
    |
    |-- Mapped source-file membership
    |   |-- derived from -------------------------> revision-owned source mappings
    |   |-- source identity + path                one entry per referenced file
    |   |-- search scope                          complete file contents
    |   `-- owners -------------------------------> referencing diagram nodes
    |
    `-- Persistence hooks
        |-- Diagram revision persisted -> derive its SearchArtifact.
        |-- Context / published bindings -> select active revision search membership.
        `-- Retire canvas -> remove active membership; retain historical records.

[P1] RevisionStore: records and relationships
|-- diagrams[diagramId]
|   `-- stable identity across edits and forks
|-- diagramRevisions[revisionId]: DiagramRevision
|   |-- diagramId / parentIds[] / createdAt
|   `-- state: DiagramState
|       |-- content: DiagramContent
|       |-- sourceContext: DiagramSourceContext
|       `-- jumps[]
|-- canvasSnapshots[snapshotId]: StoredCanvasSnapshot
|   |-- canvasId / parentId? / createdAt
|   |-- document: instances + connections + shared presentation
|   `-- diagramBindings[diagramId] -> diagramRevisionId
|-- editContexts[contextId]: DiagramEditContext
|   |-- canvasId / basePublishedRevisionId?
|   |-- baselineSnapshotId: frozen starting state
|   |-- headSnapshotId: current durable checkpoint
|   `-- version: concurrency token
|-- canvases[canvasId]: CanvasRecord
|   `-- name / publishedRevisionId -> canvas snapshot
|-- publication receipts
|   `-- request + applied change versions + resulting revision IDs
|-- History operations
|   |-- Diagram edit -> diagram revision + canvas checkpoint
|   |-- Layout edit -> canvas checkpoint; reuse diagram revisions
|   |-- Fork -> share immutable baseline; branch on edit
|   |-- Undo -> earlier checkpoint; subsequent edit keeps old branch
|   `-- Published revert -> append new revision restoring earlier state
`-- Migration
    |-- Extract existing embedded historical diagram snapshots
    |-- Preserve old appearance and reference relationships
    `-- Equal ASCII or local names do not establish shared identity

[P2] DiagramEditService.publish: reconciliation and publication
|-- publish(context, selectedChanges?)
|   |-- Check request receipt; completed request returns previous result
|   |-- Construct selected proposal; exclude unselected edits
|   |-- Validate dependencies and reviewed change versions
|   `-- Read current published StoredCanvasSnapshot
|       |-- Head unchanged -> use proposed result
|       `-- Head advanced -> DiagramEditService.merge(input)
|-- merge(input): MergeResult                         BLACK BOX
|   |-- baseline: captured starting state
|   |-- current: latest published target state
|   |-- proposed: selected incoming state
|   `-- resolutions?: explicit conflict choices
|-- MergeResult
|   |-- merged: resulting diagram and canvas state
|   |-- already-present
|   `-- conflicted: PendingMerge
|       |-- mergeId / inputToken
|       `-- conflicts[]: id / logicalTarget / description
|-- Resolution
|   `-- current | proposed | custom domain value
|       `-- Bound to conflictId and exact inputToken
|-- Publish independently applicable changes
|   |-- Validate content and affected references
|   |-- Recheck published head; if advanced, reconcile again
|   |-- Persist merged diagram revisions + canvas snapshot
|   `-- Advance published head with durable application receipt
`-- Refresh original through resolver
    |-- Preserve newer live edits and personal view state
    |-- Conflicts do not discard independent successful changes
    |-- Unresolved dependencies block dependent changes
    `-- Merge computes; publish persists and advances saved head
